title: Mini VTT project manifest
description: manifest.json at the top of a .minivtt project file (a ZIP archive), format version 2. Explained in docs/project-format.md. Fields not listed here are allowed: readers ignore what they don't know.

generator.description: The app that wrote the file, with its version. Shown when a file can't be opened.

exportedAt.description: When the file was written, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).

requires.description: Features a reader must have to read this file correctly. A reader lacking one refuses the file. Leave it out unless you need it.

path.description: A file in the archive, with / between folders: relative, no '..' and no backslashes.

extensions.description: Data for other apps and forks, one object per app, named after it. Readers ignore apps they don't know.

settings.description: The player screen setup. Only taken over by an empty library, and only the fields given.

playerScreenDiagonal.description: The player screen's diagonal in any unit, or null for no grid on the player screen.

gridSize.description: One grid square on the player screen, in the same unit as the diagonal.

portraitRotation.description: How maps and handouts taller than wide are turned when added, in degrees clockwise.

name.description: Shown in the library. Mini VTT keeps up to 80 characters.

media.description: The image (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP) or WebM video (VP8, VP9, AV1).

thumb.description: A PNG thumbnail. Made from the media when missing.

fog.description: A PNG fog mask: opaque is fogged, transparent revealed. Missing means fully fogged.

effects.description: A PNG of painted effects, coloured pixels on transparent.

mediaType.description: Informational: readers look at the file itself.

width.description: Pixels, as shown. Measured when missing or 0.

height.description: Pixels, as shown. Measured when missing or 0.

zoom.description: Player view zoom: 1 shows one map pixel per screen pixel.

pan.description: Top-left corner of the player view, in pixels of the rotated map.

grid.description: The map's own grid, or null when not measured.

circles.description: Spell areas (named after the first shape, the circle).

grid.description: In pixels of the unrotated map.

offsetX.description: Where a vertical grid line lies. Default 0.

offsetY.description: Where a horizontal grid line lies. Default 0.

feetPerCell.description: Feet one square stands for, usually 5.

x.description: Pixels of the unrotated map: the centre of a circle or square, or where a cone or line starts.

radiusFt.description: Feet: a circle's radius, a square's side, or a cone's or line's length.

angle.description: Degrees, 0 pointing right; larger angles turn clockwise. Default 0.

widthFt.description: A line's width in feet. Default 5.

color.description: The kind's colour, for readers that don't know the kind.

media.description: The image (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP).

thumb.description: A PNG thumbnail. Made from the image when missing.

width.description: Pixels, as shown. Measured when missing or 0.

height.description: Pixels, as shown. Measured when missing or 0.
